ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Which is the lowermost part of the organs?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The image is a labeled diagram of the human digestive system. It shows the mouth and throat at the top, the esophagus running downward, the stomach and other upper abdominal organs, the small and large intestines in the lower abdomen, and at the very bottom a short straight terminal section below the large intestine, just above the external opening. Reasoning: The question asks for the lowermost part of the organs shown. In digestive anatomy, the straight terminal section below the large intestine is the rectum. Therefore, the lowermost part is the rectum.
